entities.summary:
Arnobius (b. 255 CE, El Kef) was a philosopher of the Classical era, active in El Kef. He is known for his contributions to philosophical inquiry and the fields of philosophers & thinkers. Arnobius was a prominent figure in the intellectual circles of the Roman Empire, engaging in debates and discussions with notable figures of the time.

Born in El Kef, a city in the province of Africa, Arnobius was a self-taught philosopher who gained recognition for his writings on ethics, metaphysics, and epistemology. His work had a significant impact on the development of Western philosophy, influencing thinkers such as St. Augustine and the early Christian Church.

Despite his limited geographical scope, Arnobius's ideas had far-reaching consequences, shaping the intellectual landscape of the Western world for centuries to come.

One of Arnobius's most famous quotes is 'The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.'
